Money Accounts
Cash in Hand records only direct Cash receipts and Cash payments. Account records UPI / Bank receipts and UPI / Bank payments. Credit sales do not increase either balance until payment is actually received.
Transaction Ledger
Wangkhei is Singke shop: sale value reduces Due to Singke; any Wangkhei payment received by MPF adds back to Due to Singke
